response.sql: SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS avg_of_avgs FROM (SELECT e.ordersmark, o.orderflow, AVG(e.fillcount) AS group_avg FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark WHERE CAST(e.expirespot AS TEXT) BETWEEN '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY e.ordersmark, o.orderflow) t

assumptions.assumption: Executions are joined to orders with an inner join, so executions without a matching order are dropped. The date filter is a text comparison on expirespot, as requested.
Groups whose fillcount values are all NULL give a NULL group average. The outer AVG ignores them.
